scenarios.actual: 12 recorded browser steps passed for this role (run 0928075524, last step 2026-09-28T07:55:40.815Z). Auto-Docs > Download starter template (.docx) beside the title downloaded OpenLaw-Auto-Doc-Starter.docx with a page break, an instruction page showing bold, underline, italic, upper, the three date formats, currency and a Block, and an agreement using start_date, provider_name, client_name, services and fee with a confidentiality Block. Create Auto-Doc opened the Form section with "Upload a Word file to start the form." and Upload version. Upload version opened a dialog on the drop zone "Drop your Word template here" / "One .docx file" with Choose file and Upload disabled; a PDF, and two .docx files dropped at once, each showed "Choose a single Word document (.docx)." and kept no file; a .docx showed its name and size (2.9 kB) with Change file; Remove file returned to Choose file. Uploading v1 reported "File version 1 uploaded", 14 Placeholders detected, 1 Blocks detected and "12 form fields created.", then Done; the pane marked the Placeholders in Body, Header, Footer, Footnotes and Endnotes and the arbitration Block; directives made Fee amount Currency and Signing date Date. Under Fields, "Edit Counterparty name" opened an editor inside that row with Label, Template placeholder (counterparty_name), Type and Help text; a new Label renamed the row, Help text saved, and the same control closed the editor. Clauses read "A Block with no rule is always included." and the row "Always included"; "Edit the rule for arbitration" opened an editor under the row; When a rule matches / Governing law / Equals / England and Wales saved ("Included when Governing law equals England and Wales"); with Signing date and Is one of, Values showed Value 1, Add value added Value 2 and 3, Remove value 2 left two dates and the rule saved. An unclosed Block, an unclosed brace, a bad name, an unknown directive, an unknown currency and two directives were refused in the dialog quoting the text (for example "Unclosed Block: \"{{#block arbitration}}\""); a macro, an external link, an INCLUDETEXT field and a file past 32 MiB were refused with the reason; the pane stayed on File version 1. With Fee amount set to Text, Publish refused naming "Fee amount" and "{{fee_amount|currency:USD}}". Uploading v2 reported "File version 2 uploaded", "1 form field created." and "1 field no longer has a placeholder in this file. Your existing fields have been kept for review."; Signing date stayed marked "No Placeholder in file version 2". Publish offered file and form versions, pinned File version 2 with the latest form version, and a later edit left "Live since ..." unchanged with a newer-version warning. A Placeholder with a date and a currency directive became a Text field and Publish named both gaps.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough in headless Chromium (Playwright 1.63.0) by a different agent from the author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
Two files were dropped by dispatching a drop event with two File objects on the drop zone, because the file input takes one file.
The Word fixtures are the DOC-030 files renamed; their text is fictional.
